threshold_provenance: Lipinski et al., Adv Drug Deliv Rev 2001;46:3-26 (MW, LogP, HBD, HBA); Veber et al., J Med Chem 2002;45:2615-23 (rotatable bonds, TPSA); operational defaults for alert classification; PAINS weighting from Baell & Holloway, J Med Chem 2010;53:2719-40; Brenk tolerance from Brenk et al., ChemMedChem 2008;3:435-44; Ertl & Schuffenhauer, J Cheminformatics 2009;1:8 (score definition and distribution analysis). The <= 6 accessibility cutoff is a widely used community convention in virtual screening literature, not a single-paper citation.
